items.text: In a query's results, a page whose properties row is listed beside one of its ordinary blocks no longer swaps that whole group for static copies while you edit: the first click on the block opens its editor, and the editor keeps its caret and text through your own typing and save, and through Enter, Tab or another structural edit on any page. Reloading the page from disk still shows the static copy until the query reruns. Before, the click could open no editor, and once it did the first keystroke closed it and dropped the rest of what you typed (internal: UI-HCP6JS-QUERY-GROUP-LIVE-WHILE-EDITING).

regressionEvidence.reason: Catalog coverage: UI-HCP6JS-QUERY-GROUP-LIVE-WHILE-EDITING. Fail-before: proven. Gated on develop and release/0.9 (Linux native journeys).

items.text: On a touch screen, holding a sidebar **Favorites** row still opens its menu again, the same one a right-click opens (so **Open in new tab** is back within reach); holding a nested **Open tabs** row opens its **Move out of group** menu. Holding and then dragging still picks the row up to reorder it (the menu closes as you drag), a finger that moves first still scrolls, and a tap still opens it (GH #921).
